evidence: Oct 2025 NESO matches Elexon (UTC Z) at +3600 s every day of the month, including after the 26 Oct DST change (per-day RMSE 0.57-0.94 mHz; experiments/c2_gb_reference_and_feasibility). An independent 21-month lag scan (experiments/w02_independent_reproduction_of_c2) shows every 2025 BST-season month (Apr-Oct 2025) is stamped UTC+1, while Nov 2025 onward, including the 2026 summer months, is strict UTC (lag 0). Unverified months default to 0: run the lag scan before trusting a new month.
